subtitle: Lesson 3 · Chapter 1: Migrating the First Workload to Azure

code:
az group create \
  --name rg-driftwood-eastus-catalog \
  --location eastus \
  --tags environment=production app=catalog \
         owner=theo.bryant
caption: Tagged from day one, so a cost question later has something to search on.

code:
az storage account create \
  --name stdriftwoodimages \
  --resource-group rg-driftwood-eastus-catalog \
  --location eastus \
  --sku Standard_LRS \
  --kind StorageV2
caption: Standard tier, StorageV2 -- the right default for product images.

code:
az vm create \
  --resource-group rg-driftwood-eastus-catalog \
  --name vm-catalog01 \
  --image Ubuntu2204 \
  --size Standard_B2s \
  --admin-username azureuser \
  --generate-ssh-keys
caption: One command: the VM, its disk, NIC, public IP, and NSG.
